rule: Every symbol on the reels is real Xtrata-inscribed work, an Xtrata asset or a real on-chain record. Nothing is drawn or imitated by hand. Nothing here needs twinning: it was born on chain, so nothing is shown NOT YET FOREVER. Art is chosen with Math.random only after the engine has fixed each result.
readVia: https://xtrata.xyz/i/<id>?contractId=<core>&network=mainnet and https://xtrata.xyz/hiro/mainnet/... (the Xtrata proxy of the Hiro API), read 1 November 2026

vault.name: Cicada call
vault.source: Nine of the cicada seeds above, each with its signature call rendered by renderSignatureCall(seed, tier) from the same engine (6.5 s, 44.1 kHz, the seed fingerprinted into the sound), encoded to MP3 40 kbps; the tile's waveform is the call's real 72-bin RMS envelope.

sound.sessionMode: Analog Kit pack (CC0-1.0) from the Audionaut sample library, audionaut-library/packs/analogkit.audpack, extracted with art-src/extract-analogkit.mjs. Credits travel with the pack: Big Rusty Drums, Swirly Drums, Unruly Drums (Karoryfer Samples); VCSL and Virtuosity Drums (Versilian Studios).
sound.reelStops: Short slices of the same cicada calls, plus a rim hit and a click.
sound.jackpot: A layered synth swell made in Web Audio, over the kit.

permissions.ownProjects: Every logo on this machine is an Xtrata, Audionals, Audionaut or Forever Twins asset (Jim's own), so no third-party logo permission is needed. Bitcoin is shown only as the ₿ sign and the word STACKS is set in type on the gamble coin: no third-party logo file is used.
